$comment: Proposed tag vocabulary, for Roy to prune. Not pinned until scripts/pin-tags.js has resolved every slug against the catalogue and you have deleted the ones that are wrong. RAWG has 9,736 tags and most are store plumbing (steam-cloud, full-controller-support) or non-English duplicates (dlia-odnogo-igroka, ekshen, atmosfera). A vocabulary is a curated list, not a top-40 by count. Same reasoning as decision 0002 on the hand-written feel lines: where the automatic version gives garbage, a person picks.
howToUse: Delete anything you would not pick from a dropdown. Add anything missing. Then run: node scripts/pin-tags.js — it resolves each slug, reports the real game count, and refuses to pin one that does not exist or is too thin to be worth offering.
